Title: How to Redownload Archived or Deleted Games on Nintendo Switch Lite
IntroLines: Need to redownload archived or deleted games on your Nintendo Switch Lite?
In this video, I'll show you how to get them back in just a few simple taps without paying twice.

Sections.Heading: METHOD 1: REDOWNLOAD ARCHIVED GAMES FROM THE HOME MENU
Steps: •  First, turn on your Nintendo Switch Lite and make sure it is connected to the internet.
•  Scroll through your HOME Menu to find the game icon with the cloud symbol over its title.
•  Select the game icon with the " A " button on your console.
•  A prompt will appear stating that the software data must be downloaded.
•  Select " Download " on the screen.
•  The download will begin immediately in the background.
•  Finally, return to your HOME Menu and verify the download progress bar appears under the game tile.
Sections.Bridge: If the game icon is not showing on your home screen, you can easily load it from your virtual game cards.

Sections.Heading: METHOD 2: REDOWNLOAD ARCHIVED GAMES VIA VIRTUAL GAME CARDS
Steps: •  First, from your HOME Menu, navigate to and select " Virtual Game Cards " from the bottom toolbar.
•  Select the user profile that originally purchased the game.
•  Scroll through your digital card library and highlight your archived title.
•  Select the game card to open its card details.
•  Select " Load on this system " to initiate the software download.
•  Wait a few seconds for the license to authenticate with Nintendo's servers.
•  Finally, return to your HOME Menu and confirm the game icon has reappeared and started installing.
Sections.Bridge: If you completely deleted the game and removed its icon from your console, let's redownload it from the Nintendo eShop.

Sections.Heading: METHOD 3: REDOWNLOAD COMPLETELY DELETED GAMES FROM THE NINTENDO ESHOP
Steps: •  First, from your HOME Menu, open the " Nintendo eShop " from the bottom toolbar.
•  Select the user profile linked to your Nintendo Account purchase.
•  Navigate to the top-right corner and select your " Profile Icon " to open Account Information.
•  Scroll down the left sidebar and select " Redownload " .
•  Browse through your purchased software history to locate your deleted game.
•  Select the orange " Download Cloud " icon next to the game's title.
•  Press the physical " HOME Button " to return to your main dashboard.
•  Finally, verify on your HOME Menu that the game is downloading and ready to play once finished.

OutroLines: And that's how you can redownload archived and deleted games on your Nintendo Switch Lite.
